## `neuro.date.setDate`

Instance method on `Date.prototype`.

> Sets the numeric day-of-the-month value of the Date object using local time.

## Signatures

```ts
setDate(input: { date: <receiver>; date_arg: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Date.prototype.setDate` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
